setup: Triangle ABC has angle A = [[A]]°, angle B = [[B]]°, and side a = [[a]].

steps.say: The law of sines says every triangle obeys a/sin A = b/sin B — the ratio of a side to the sine of its opposite angle is the same for all three.
Rearranged for the side wanted, b = a·sin(B)/sin(A) = [[a]]·sin([[B]]°)/sin([[A]]°).
